items.name: Wizstar R1
items.tagline: Seedance 2.0-level product videos at a lower cost
items.description: Wizstar R1 is an in-house AI video model built for affordable, everyday creation. Combine up to nine reference images and videos to generate 5–15-second videos with native audio, guided by your products, characters, scenes, and styles. R1 excels at animation and 3D content and matches Seedance 2.0's usable-output rate for product videos in internal tests. Eligible members enjoy unlimited, credit-free generation, giving creators more freedom to experiment and refine their ideas.

items.name: Depost AI
items.tagline: The LinkedIn AI agent that learns what works for your brand
items.description: Depost AI scores every LinkedIn post you've published against your own average, finds what's winning in your niche, then plans the month, writes in your voice, and designs the graphics. You approve every post, and it publishes through LinkedIn's official API. It also drafts replies to the conversations worth joining, so posts turn into leads—works in the app, or inside Claude and ChatGPT over MCP.

items.name: Contral
items.tagline: The AI coding agent that checks its work and teaches you
items.description: Contral is out of beta. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or Copilot CLI inside Contral, on your own account. Contral checks every turn against what you asked for and sends smaller models a specific correction, explains every change with a teaching card, and undoes a whole turn in one click. Plus Defense Mode, video explanations by Scrimba, and Learn mode in 5 languages. In VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and more, or the Contral IDE. Free to start.

items.name: Periscope
items.tagline: Turn any work into an API
items.description: Describe a task and get an endpoint for it. An agent does the work through the screen on its own cloud desktop, in any software, however old. Call it over REST, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. The Free plan needs no card.

items.name: Pushary Calls
items.tagline: Miss your AI agent’s ping? Pushary calls you.
items.description: Your AI agent stops to ask before it does anything big. If you're at lunch, it sits there until you're back. Pushary sends the question to your phone. Miss it, and Pushary calls you. You hear what the agent wants and say yes, no, or what to do instead. Then it keeps working. Calls only ring in hours you pick. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and more.

items.name: RightFont 2026
items.description: RightFont 2026 is rebuilt from the ground up for a smarter, faster and more intuitive font management experience. Preview and apply fonts directly in your designs, discover fonts with on-device AI, share libraries effortlessly, and clean up duplicates with Font Insights. Built for speed, even with 200,000 fonts. Spend less time managing fonts and more time creating.

items.name: Espresso 27
items.tagline: The web editor for people who love the Mac
items.description: The biggest Espresso ever. A new look for macOS 27, an AI that builds across your whole site without a line of it leaving your Mac, and an editor with far more under the hood.

items.name: Remove Silence
items.tagline: Cut the silence from audio in your browser, free
items.description: Drop an audio or video file, see every pause on the waveform, tune the threshold and download a tighter WAV. It runs on your device: no upload, no account, no watermark. For the cut video, QuellCut does it on iPhone.

items.name: snibl
items.tagline: Save highlighted text from any app, then ask AI about it
items.description: Stop losing the things you read. Highlight text in any app on Mac or Windows and Snibl saves it with its source and context, so you can find it later. Then just ask: Snibl AI answers your questions using your own saved snippets. Software you actually own

items.name: ChickyTutor
items.tagline: A language tutor that knows you better daily. Now on iOS
items.description: Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with our new iOS app for iPhone and iPad. Talk face to face with your AI language tutor, answer out loud, get gentle feedback when something needs fixing, and try again straight away. You can pick your language and level, follow guided Journey chapters in supported languages, and keep your practice synced across iPhone, iPad, Android, and the web. Try it at https://www.chickytutor.com/mobileapp

items.name: Woomool
items.tagline: AI Canvas where thinking becomes tangible
items.description: Woomool is a AI canvas tastefully designed for ideation, knowledge management, and live collaboration. Clean, unobtrusive, and beautiful, it inspires you to focus and go deep into your thinking.

items.name: slay
items.tagline: AI composition guide camera app for iPhone
items.description: slay is an iPhone camera app that overlays 14 composition guides directly on your live camera view — Portrait 1, Portrait 2, Close Up, Side Chick, Travel Shot, One-Third, Two-Third, Vanishing Point, One-Point Vertex, Two-Point Vertex, Triangle 1, Triangle 2, Aerial Triangle, One-Point Aerial — each with the camera height, angle, zoom and distance to use, plus 38 built-in LUTs, so photos are framed and post-ready without editing.

items.name: Prosed AI 2.0 + MCP
items.tagline: Your company's words, assembled into a book
items.description: Prosed AI is now for businesses. Your team has already published the ideas. Prosed AI assembles them into a non-fiction book inside your assistant. The Source Map and review packet help reviewers focus on the joins. Bring a body of work, not just an idea. AI-assisted bridges are marked for review. One book: $299, once. Free until the outline. $149 until Mon Nov 30

items.name: Onset
items.tagline: AI reviews, titles and thumbnails for YouTube creators
items.description: Onset reads your own YouTube Analytics and reviews each upload 48 hours after it goes live, then drafts titles in your voice and thumbnails in your channel's style. Read-only: it never posts. We're letting creators in from the waitlist, a few at a time.

items.name: gpyou
items.tagline: The OpenRouter for compute for the cheapest GPU in stock
items.description: One CLI for GPU clouds worldwide. gpyou rents the cheapest GPU in stock, moves to the next offer when one is sold out, and bills per second from prepaid credit. Run containers, fine-tune, serve models or a coding model of your own.

items.name: Ploid
items.tagline: People search for AI agents, across 2B+ profiles
items.description: Ploid is a people search engine with a living index of over two billion people. Search by role, company, skills or location, get up to 150 results per request, and merge someone's professional, social and personal sites into one Superprofile. Agents can reason over posts, photos and talks, not just database fields. Available as API, CLI and MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor.

items.name: Spark AI
items.tagline: AI-native permitting & diligence services for data centers
items.description: Will that data center actually come online? Spark offers AI-native services built on a permitting intelligence platform: agents research 20,000+ jurisdictions, and an expert reviews every deliverable. Used by NextEra, Prologis, Intersect (Google), and others with a combined 200 GW pipeline. Three services: Stakeholder Intelligence (who decides, how they voted), Permit Matrices (which permits, from whom, timelines), and Project Diligence (risks from regulation, utilities & power, competition).

items.name: Form Action Store
items.tagline: Discover, create and grow with powerful digital tools.
items.description: 💸 Build your online business and unlock new opportunities! 📊 Digital training: DSA, EML & CYL 🚀 Learn social media marketing and online business strategies. 🔥 Beginner-friendly resources to help you take action. 👇 Start building your digital future today!
